_note: The kinds table: one per kind, read by the lock and by gate.py. cpu: a whole number of cpu slots 1..the layout agent_cap, set only by gate.py --measure and a reviewed commit; a run may ask for fewer (--cores), never more. medium (medium_cores) and heavy (the half cap, or every core inside an owner whole hold) stay as aliases. gpu: 0 (none) or pool (the whole gpu pool; share true lets --gpu-share training take one gpu slot). warn_min: a WARNING past this, never a kill. Sizes change only by a PM-reviewed commit. aliases: a retired name and the kind it books now (generic names); a caller passing one still books, and a record written under one compares equal to the kind.

engine-test.why: the generic name for a repository's test run

engine-run.why: the generic name for a run of the application (a game engine, a live client)
